title: 運動会の場面（小学生）
lead: かけっこ・玉入れ・綱引き・リレーなど、小学校の運動会の場面を12点にまとめました。おたよりや行事予定の資料に使えます。
subject_en: Japanese elementary school sports day scenes, each ONE small scene of two to four children in white gym clothes with red or white caps, centred in its cell, flat style, simple round faces with dot eyes and a smile, no school logos. Outlines are closed and darker than the fill; light parts (snow, paper, white fur, plates) are warm cream (#FFF6E0) or tinted, never pure white. No letters, no text, no logos.
items: children running a footrace side by side toward a finish tape
children throwing red and white balls up toward a tall basket on a pole
children pulling a thick rope in a tug of war, leaning back
a child passing a baton to the next runner
children rolling a huge ball overhead along a line
children forming a cavalry team with one rider wearing a red cap
children dancing in a row with pom-poms raised
children cheering with fans and a team flag
children doing warm-up stretches in a line
three children standing on a podium with medals
a family sitting on a picnic sheet eating bento boxes
parents under a tent holding cameras and fans watching
